description: This file defines interfaces and utility classes related to formatting and resolving options within the Orleans framework, specifically dealing with option formatting, categorization, and name resolution.

classes.name: OptionFormattingUtilities
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods for formatting key-value pairs and option names.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a key-value pair into a string using a specified or default formatting.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Formats the name of an options object, optionally using a custom format string.
